title: Yousician Metric0 Field Completeness Score
dataSources: Yousician lessons (`yousician:lesson`), Simply Piano practice (`simplypiano:session`), TonalEnergy tuning (`tonalenergy:tuning`), Pro Metronome sessions (`prometronome:session`), and forScore practice (`forscore:practice`).
app: Yousician lessons, Simply Piano practice, TonalEnergy tuning logs, Pro Metronome sessions, and forScore sheet-music practice exports ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=yousician:metric0
| eval complete=if(isnotnull(value) AND isnotnull(duration_min),1,0)
| stats sum(complete) as complete_rows, count as total
| eval completeness_pct=round(100*complete_rows/total,1)
description: Measures how often yousician metric0 events include both value and duration.
value: Incomplete exports break joins and dashboards; completeness scoring catches schema drift early.
implementation: Require `value` and `duration_min` on yousician metric0 events and track completeness percentage.
visualization: Single-value gauge of field completeness percent.
grandmaExplanation: It gives you how often your yousician metric0 exports arrive with the key numbers filled in.
